_note: DEMO MULTI-ROUND RANKED BOARD (D17). Three columns, so each column is a ROUND: the board shows one at a time and the host advances with the toolbar. This file exists because D17's whole user value was unreachable from shipped content — demo-feud.json has a single column, so the round machinery and the 'Next round' control could not be exercised from any board in the repo. Strikes (D15) are per round, so this is also the only board on which 'a round resets clean' is visible. Every survey question and point value below is INVENTED for the demo: no real survey was consulted and none is implied.
